title: Page
description: A generic, cursor-based pagination envelope for list responses. Implementations SHOULD use opaque cursors rather than numeric offsets so that pagination is stable under concurrent writes. The `items` array holds the page's elements; the concrete element type is fixed by whichever operation returns the page.

items.description: The elements on this page. The element type is defined by the returning operation.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. `null` or absent means there are no further pages.

totalCount.description: Optional total number of matching elements across all pages, when the implementation can compute it cheaply.
